subject: general
question: Which of the following industries has developed the most on the banks of the Hooghly river?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Jute Industry**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **West Bengal** has a jute industry that dates back to the 17th century.
 
• West Bengal accounts for 71% of land in the country that is under **jute cultivation**. Presently, jute from West Bengal makes up about 73% of the country’s production.
 
• The **first jute mill** was built in **Rishra** on the river in 1855, which is one of many reasons why the jute industry is situated close to the **Hooghly**.

 
• The river offered water for the retting of fiber, washing, and dyeing processes of jute, as well as an efficient way to convey the fiber to other locations.
 
• The area beside the river was fertile for **jute farming**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **Gujarat's Porbandar**, the first cement factory in India was established. Currently, Madhya Pradesh is India's top cement-producing state. Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Andhra Pradesh come next.
 
• **Iron and steel industry** is an important industry in India. India ranks second in the world in production of iron and steel. **Odisha** is the largest iron ore-producing state in India.
 
• India's textile sector is widespread across the nation. **Cotton** is mostly produced in the Indian states of **Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, and Maharashtra**.
